note: Single source of truth for the EngineOS standard project layout. Each entry is a relative dir plus the seeds copied into it when nothing occupies the name. A seed src of "@path" is relative to the EngineOS repo root (reuse in-repo files); any other src is a basename under templates/project-layout/. dest is the filename written into the target dir. Mirror of the table in docs/specs/2026-06-19-project-layout-standard-design.md. audits/ is intentionally absent (created on first /audit). hooks/layout-manifest.sh reads this file with jq and keeps a literal copy as its jq-free fallback.
